metadata.name: GetMerchantAuthorizations
metadata.description: This API is used to get all the available Merchant Authorizations details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 205136549 Condition:Mandatory If Merchant ID not Inputted in API Request or Other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Specific ID Assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 562489 Condition:Mandatory If Merchant Number Not Inputted in API Request or Other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted

request_fields.name: AuthPostFromDate
request_fields.description: From Date of Auth Posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 12/11/2020

request_fields.name: AuthPostToDate
request_fields.description: From Date of Auth Posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 12/11/2020

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of Card holder/Account Holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:Mandatory If other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ApplicationNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:8002201421 Condition:Mandatory If other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of account holder. Valid Values:a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:John Condition:Mandatory If other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last name of account holder. Valid Values:a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:John Condition:Mandatory If other Conditional Input Parameters are not Inputted. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch. Default Value would be 100 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX Example: 20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: XX Example: 12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.description: TotalRecordCount

children.name: TransactionRecords

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the transaction being posted. Valid :0-9 a-z Format:XXXX Example:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Allowable Values: 20

children.name: MerchantName
children.description: Merchant Name which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid :A-Z Format:XXXXXX Example:ABCD LLC Allowable Values: 40

children.name: MerchantNumber
children.description: Merchant Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid :0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 205136549

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of Card holder/Account Holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ApplicationNumber
children.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: 8002201421

children.name: FirstName
children.description: First name of account holder. Valid Values:a-z Format: XXXX Example: John Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastName
children.description: Last name of account holder. Valid Values:a-z Format: XXXX Example: John Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AuthorizedSource
children.description: Must return the Authorized Source: Email, SMS or CSR or Cancelled by Provider.

children.name: AuthorizationStatus
children.description: Must return Authorization Status. Outstanding = If Transaction Authorization is Outstanding Rejected = If Transaction Authorization is Rejected Expired = If Transaction Authorization is Aged-Off Decline = If Manual Auth from CC is Declined Matched = If the Transaction Authorization is Accepted Allowable Values: 30

children.name: RejectReason
children.description: Must display the Reject reason only for transaction type ‘Rejected’ and must be updated with the latest Response. Valid Values: Did Not Authorize, Services Not Yet Scheduled, Services Scheduled Beyond 30 Days, Wrong Amount,  Wrong Plan or Cancelled by Provider Format: XXXX Example: Wrong Plan Allowable Values: 100

children.name: EmailSMSVerificationServiceCallDateTime
children.description: Must display the Date and Time when CC called the GS EMAIL/SMS Wrapper Service, must be updated with latest Response. Valid Values:0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00

children.name: EmailSMSVerificationServiceStatus
children.description: Must display if the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper Service calling was ‘Successful’ or ‘Error’, must be updated with latest Status. Valid Values:‘Successful’ or ‘Error’ Example: Successful Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProcedureCompletedorScheduled
children.description: Must Display ‘Yes’ or ‘No’ depending on the Account Holders Response via Authorization Web Page while accepting the Authorization Request, must be updated with latest Response. Valid Values:Yes or No Example: Yes Allowable Values: 30

children.name: EmailVerificationStatus
children.description: Must display Verified or Non-Verified, depending on the response of the EMAIL/SMS Valid Values:Verified or Non-Verified Example: Verified Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MobilePhoneVerificationStatus
children.description: Must display Verified or Non-Verified, depending on the response of the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service, must be auto updated with the most recent status whenever the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called. Valid Values:Verified or Non-Verified Example: Verified Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmailAddressValid
children.description: Must display Valid or Invalid, depending on the response of the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service, must be auto updated with the most recent response whenever the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called Valid Values:Valid or Invalid Example: Invalid Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmailAddressUsed
children.description: Must display the most recent Email ID used as per the response of whenever recently the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called. Valid Values:0-9, a-z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 300

children.name: EmailDeliveryStatus
children.description: Must display Delivered or Undelivered, depending on the response of the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service, must be auto updated with the most recent response whenever the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called. Valid Values:Delivered or Undelivered Example:  Delivered Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmailDeliveryDateTime
children.description: Must display the most recent Email Delivery date and time as per the response of whenever recently the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called Valid Values:0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example:  12/11/2020 11:00:00

children.name: MobilePhoneValid
children.description: Must display Valid or Invalid, depending on the response of the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service, must be auto updated with the most recent response whenever the EMAIL/SMS Wrapper service is called. Valid Values:Valid or Invalid Example:  Invalid Allowable Values: 50

children.name: SMSDeliveryStatus
children.description: Must display Delivered or Undelivered, depending on the in AuthUPDATE. Valid Values:Delivered or Undelivered Example: Delivered Allowable Values: 50

children.name: SMSDeliveryDateTime
children.description: Must display the most recent SMS Delivery date and time as per the in AuthUPDATE. Valid Values:0 – 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00

children.name: Amount
children.description: Amount for which transaction occurred. Valid Values:0-9 Format: $XX.XX Example: $20.00

children.name: HoldAmount
children.description: Amount which need to be put on hold. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

children.name: TransactionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time of transaction occurred. Valid Values:0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM: SS Example: 12/11/2020 11:00:00

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example: Purchase/Payment Allowable Values: 100

children.name: CreditPlanMaster
children.description: Plan name using which transaction was generated. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example: 6051 Allowable Values: 100

TransactionRecords.CreditPlanMaster: 6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full
